title: A Funny Face
content: Have you seen this painting of Ada Lovelace, the Victorian lady who helped invent the computer? Her eyes are kind of close together, but you get the idea. The image was created by a computer.Image courtesy Daniel Russell @danielrussrussNow look at the image again. Do you see a dog with a white nose? Ada's eyes become the nostrils.I found that once I saw the dog, I couldn't go back to Ada Lovelace again.Most humans see the Victorian lady first. What does Google reverse image search think it is? Mostly it think's it's a dog, but there are some ladies mixed in, too.
